readme_preprocessing: Resize to 640x640 (Stretch) -- NOT letterboxed/padded; aspect ratio is distorted by this stretch, disclosed as a data-quality caveat
source.readme_augmentation: None declared by Roboflow's own README, however manual inspection (see data_quality_findings) found baked-in 4-panel mosaic composites with noise/rotation in a meaningful fraction of images -- likely an artifact of an earlier augmentation pass whose OUTPUT was exported as if it were source data, not something this project applied.

manual_class_semantics_confirmation.method: Rendered ground-truth boxes on real sample images per class and visually inspected (models/evaluation/vision_v1.2_data_audit/contact_sheets/, and ad-hoc single-example renders under external-data/inspect/ during this pass).
manual_class_semantics_confirmation.note: Images are stored as RGB-mode files at 640x640 (see readme_preprocessing: stretch resize, not letterboxed padding), and class-to-box semantics are correct where checked. However, see data_quality_findings below for real, disclosed anomalies found beyond the specific corruption pattern (letterboxed grayscale) this check was designed to catch.

grayscale_content_despite_rgb_color_expo.method: np.array(image.convert('RGB')); flagged 'grayscale-like' if mean(|R-G|)+mean(|G-B|) < 1.0 across the full frame. Deterministic seed=42 sample of 200 images per split.
grayscale_content_despite_rgb_color_expo.interpretation: A majority of TRAIN images (65%) and a meaningful fraction of TEST images (30.5%) are monochrome/IR/CCTV-derived content saved in an RGB container, while VALID is almost entirely true color (2%). This is a genuine, disclosed data-quality surprise: the requested 'color' export is not uniformly color, and the color/grayscale mix differs materially between splits (a train/valid distribution mismatch), which the promotion-gate evaluation must account for.

mosaic_composite_images.method: Manual visual inspection of real sample images (external-data/inspect/no_hardhat_sample_*.png, external-data/inspect/random_*.png) rendered with ground-truth boxes.
mosaic_composite_images.finding: A meaningful fraction of images (observed repeatedly across random and no_hardhat-containing samples) are 4-panel mosaic composites of unrelated scenes (e.g. a construction site tile next to an unrelated fashion/selfie photo tile), sometimes rotated and with added visual noise. Ground-truth boxes are placed correctly on the head/torso region within their own tile, but 3 of 4 panels are frequently off-domain (non-industrial) content. This looks like an upstream augmentation pass whose rendered output was exported as static images rather than applied only at training time.
mosaic_composite_images.impact: Reduces effective real-world scene diversity/realism versus the raw image count, and means 'no_helmet' labels sometimes sit on incidental photos (e.g. a fashion selfie) rather than genuine industrial no-helmet scenes.

high_fraction_of_unannotated_background_.finding: 47% of all pooled images have zero person/helmet/vest/no_helmet boxes. Filename inspection shows many are off-domain negative/background stock photos (e.g. wildfire/smoke images) -- the parent Roboflow project appears scoped to a broader 'industrial safety' concept (fire, smoke, falls) than just PPE compliance, of which this project only uses the 4 PPE-relevant classes.

high_within_split_near_duplicate_density.note: Consistent with many images being consecutive-frame extractions from the same source videos (filenames like 'vlcsnap-...', 'youtube-...', '*_mp4-NN'). Cross-split leakage was separately checked (see leakage_check below) and found clean, i.e. Roboflow's own split assignment appears to keep same-video scene groups together.

leakage_check.tool: backend/scripts/vision_data/check_vision_leakage.py (extended with LSH banding for scale, see script docstring)
leakage_check.result: PASS -- No train/val/test leakage detected (exit code 0)

prepared_manifest: external-data/vision_manifests/industrial_safety_manifest.json (gitignored; regenerate via backend/scripts/vision_data/prepare_vision_data.py against the extracted+converted dataset, see this file's source section for the original zip sha256)
